response.sql: WITH overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(HGB) AS overall_hgb FROM Laboratory WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL), patient_avgs AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS patient_hgb FROM Laboratory WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), above_average_patients AS (SELECT pa.ID, pa.patient_hgb, oa.overall_hgb FROM patient_avgs pa CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE pa.patient_hgb > oa.overall_hgb), above_avg_avg AS (SELECT AVG(patient_hgb) AS avg_of_above_avg FROM above_average_patients) SELECT aap.ID, aap.patient_hgb, aap.patient_hgb - aap.overall_hgb AS above_overall_avg, aap.patient_hgb - aaa.avg_of_above_avg AS above_above_avg_patients_avg FROM above_average_patients aap CROSS JOIN above_avg_avg aaa ORDER BY above_above_avg_patients_avg DESC LIMIT 10
